question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a yellow ball, Claire has a silver ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a red ball, Fred has a pink ball, and Gertrude has a purple ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Finally, Dave and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Eve has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) yellow ball
(C) silver ball
(D) white ball
(E) red ball
(F) pink ball
(G) purple ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (grey, yellow, silver, white, red, pink, purple)
1. Bob and Claire swap: (grey, silver, yellow, white, red, pink, purple)
2. Gertrude and Claire swap: (grey, silver, purple, white, red, pink, yellow)
3. Dave and Eve swap: (grey, silver, purple, red, white, pink, yellow)
4. Eve and Gertrude swap: (grey, silver, purple, red, yellow, pink, white)
5. Fred and Gertrude swap: (grey, silver, purple, red, yellow, white, pink)
6. Alice and Gertrude swap: (pink, silver, purple, red, yellow, white, grey)
7. Dave and Alice swap: (red, silver, purple, pink, yellow, white, grey)
Eve has the yellow ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
